name: agent-context-ab
question: Does the repo agent loop (skills + gate) change first-contact protocol behavior versus a naked agent and versus QUICKSTART_JURY text in context?

skills.skill: .agents/skills/sbf-verify for internal checks; arena procedure via AGENTS.md

design.arena: local arenad, isolated state dir and port per run (repo rule)

metrics.primary: first_contact_4xx_rate (share of HTTP game calls rejected by schema/phase on first attempt)
metrics.secondary: mean payout vs builtin opponents (greedy, tactical)
metrics.activation: observed skill/QUICKSTART load in the session log, reported per arm, never assumed

power.source: docs/research/harness-learning-20261020 (measured SD of paired payout diffs 8.16M, 64k tokens/game LLM arm)

error_branch.test: McNemar paired binary (first-contact call accepted vs rejected)
error_branch.note: rounded up to a multiple of seats; primary metric drives N, payout branch rides the same games

power.cost_note: 36 seeds x 3 arms x ~64k tokens; the naked arm is expected to cost less (early errors shorten games); refine after a 2-seed pilot

decision_rule.run: only after owner approves the token spend
decision_rule.payout: exact Wilcoxon two-sided p < 0.05 plus bootstrap CI excluding 0 (tools/eval_report.py)
decision_rule.report: tools/eval_report.py --write, committed raw logs under docs/research/<name>/
